title: Small Group Hoover Dam, Powerplant & O'Callahan Bridge Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join our all-inclusive, award-winning SMALL GROUP TOURS today! Ranking as TripAdvisor's 5th best tour operator in America with 20 years of experience, our personal, small group Hoover Dam tours are designed to maximize your time and experience. 

Immerse yourself with our tour to the engineering marvel that is Hoover Dam. This intimate, engaging experience with a small, friendly group designed to maximize your expereince. Our tour guides will share in-depth knowledge, history, and facts about Hoover Dam. 

Tours include hotel pickup/dropoff, photo stop at Fabulous Las Vegas sign, breakfast, photo stop at Lake Meade Overlook, power plant pass, guided walk onto O'Callahan-Tillman Bridge, and guided tour onto Hoover Dam.
